customer_message.subject: Cold bedrooms at Eichholzweg 29
customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

My family rents a 3.5-room flat at Eichholzweg 29 in Muttenz from Verwaltung Emme & Söhne. I attach our lease.

Our main problem is the heating: the boiler cuts out at night and the bedrooms are cold in the morning. It has happened almost every night since mid-September. We have reported it three times by phone.

Probably because of the cold, there is condensation running down the walls and mould on the window frames, which our five-year-old's doctor thinks is behind the cough she has had for weeks. Emme & Söhne simply says we should heat and air more. I think someone who actually knows about heating systems needs to look at why the boiler fails, since we are going round in circles.

I've been told I could pay our rent to the official deposit office instead of to the landlord, and I intend to do that from December if nothing changes.

Could you let me know how to proceed?

Kind regards,
Eleanor Kowalczyk
